name_input: FLOWSTAR ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED; FLOW STAR ENGINEERING PVT. LTD
product_summary: Faridabad (Haryana) manufacturer of industrial process instrumentation. Catalogue (IndiaMART listing of Flowstar Engineering Private Limited, Plot No.7f/2, Northern India Complex, 20/3, Mathura Road, Faridabad 121005; director Sumit Saini; GST 06AABCF0381M1ZN; CIN U74999HR2006PTC043390; IEC 0507080424): flow meters (rotameter / metal tube rotameter, electromagnetic flowmeter, vortex flow meter, turbine flow meter, digital flow meter, oxygen flow meter, water flow meter, magnetic water meter, sight flow indicators), level instruments (level gauge/indicator/transmitter/switch, top- and side-mounted magnetic level switches, displacer type level switch, radio frequency level switch, water level gauge), pressure instruments (pressure gauge, pressure transmitter, differential pressure transmitter, pressure switch, pressure controller), temperature instruments (temperature sensor, temperature indicator, temperature transmitter, thermocouple, thermowell), plus U-tube and acrylic-body manometers, orifice plates, industrial strainer. Source: https://www.flowstar.in/ (IndiaMART-hosted company page, read 2026).
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared 'Nature of Business: Manufacturer', 26-50 employees, own facility in Faridabad). No trader signs found in the catalogue; no independent corporate website located, so the only product source is the IndiaMART listing.
comment: HS 902610 ('instruments for measuring or checking the flow or level of liquids or gases') is CORRECT for the core line — rotameters, electromagnetic/vortex/turbine flow meters, water meters, level gauges and level switches all fall in 9026.10. Match = partial, not exact, because a large part of the declared catalogue sits outside 9026.10: pressure gauges/transmitters/switches/controllers -> 9026.20; thermocouples, thermowells, temperature sensors/transmitters/indicators -> 9025.80 (thermometers/pyrometers) or 9025.90 parts; orifice plates, manometers and instrument parts -> 9026.90; industrial strainer -> 8481.80 (taps/cocks/valves) or 7326.90 if a plain fabricated steel item. Industry claim 'IT и электроника' is a MISCLASSIFICATION: this is industrial process instrumentation / mechanical engineering (flow, level, pressure, temperature measurement), not IT or electronics. No HS mismatch rejection — company retained, code 902610 confirmed as the primary code with the additional codes above to be used per line item. All product data is from the company's own catalogue/IndiaMART page: заявлено, не подтверждено — no customs line or shipment record was checked in this task (out of scope), so no product line is corroborated by a customs entry. No independent website, no export/import documentation and no product datasheets were found publicly; revenue, volumes and registry data not researched per scope.
